# arcane_api_subresource (Resource)

Keeps a subresource of an Arcane object, such as `members` or `permissions`, at the value `body` declares. The provider does not interpret the subresource; it calls the HTTP methods that API discovery lists for it.

| Terraform | Method | Without that method |
|---|---|---|
| create | `PUT` | `POST`; an error when neither is allowed |
| refresh | `GET` | no request, the state is kept |
| update | `PUT` | `PATCH` with `application/merge-patch+json` and the whole body; a replacement when neither is allowed |
| destroy | `DELETE` | no request, only the state is removed, with a warning |

Things to know:

- Create does not check whether the subresource already has a value. It overwrites the value on the server, unlike `arcane_api_resource`, which fails when the object exists.
- Without `DELETE`, the value stays on the server after destroy. What `DELETE` does is up to the API server.
- When the subresource, its parent kind or its group/version is no longer in API discovery, refresh fails, and destroy only removes the state with a warning.
- Refresh compares only the fields that both `body` and the `GET` response have. A field only the server has is not drift, and a field the server dropped is not detected. `metadata.name` and `metadata.namespace` are not compared, because the path names the object and the server may name the response its own way.
- When drift is found and the subresource allows neither `PUT` nor `PATCH`, the plan replaces the resource, so a `POST` runs again. Use it for subresources whose value is declared, not for one-off actions.
- Two resources that manage the same subresource overwrite each other.
- The parent object is neither created nor deleted. Reference an `arcane_api_resource` to order them.

The token needs the RBAC verbs that the methods above use on `<plural>/<subresource>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Keep the members subresource of a namespace at the declared value.
# Create overwrites the current value on the server without checking it first.
resource "arcane_api_subresource" "qa_members" {
  api_version = "v1"
  kind        = "Namespace"
  name        = "qa"
  subresource = "members"

  body = <<-YAML
metadata:
  name: namespace
  namespace: qa
spec:
  members:
    - subject:
        kind: Group
        name: qa-team
      role: editor
  customGrants: []
YAML
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_version` (String) apiVersion of the parent resource kind, not of the subresource object, such as `sample.arcane.pubg.io/v1`.
- `kind` (String) Kind of the parent resource, not of the subresource object.
- `name` (String) Name of the parent object.
- `subresource` (String) Name of the subresource, as API discovery lists it for the kind, such as `claim` for `runneridtokens/claim`.

### Optional

- `body` (String, Sensitive) YAML of the subresource object. Always sensitive; see `desired_object` for its changes. When it has no `apiVersion` or `kind`, the provider fills them from API discovery. It does not fill `metadata`. When a request fails, string values from `body` that the server repeats in its error are shown as `******`.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the parent object. Required for a namespaced kind, and not allowed for a cluster-scoped one.
- `sensitive_fields` (Block, Optional) Fields to read as `******` in `desired_object` and `live_object`. A selected field also covers every field under it. Changing it sends the body again. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--sensitive_fields))

### Read-Only

- `desired_object` (Dynamic) The object the provider sends, as an object value, with the fields `sensitive_fields` selects replaced by `******`.
- `id` (String) API path of the subresource
- `live_object` (Dynamic) Object the server returned for the last write or refresh, as an object value, with the fields `sensitive_fields` selects replaced by `******`. It is not sensitive, so plans show server-side changes. Secret values that `sensitive_fields` does not select show in plans and state; select them, or read the subresource with the ephemeral resource.

<a id="nestedblock--sensitive_fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sensitive_fields`

Optional:

- `jq_path_expressions` (List of String) jq path expressions that select the fields, such as `.spec.integrations[] | select(.type == "slack") | .token`. Each expression has one second to evaluate.
- `json_pointers` (List of String) JSON Pointers (RFC 6901) of the fields, such as `/data/password`. A pointer to a field the object does not have selects nothing.
